Package com.ceichhorst.reservation.service

Class ServiceManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ceichhorst.reservation.service.ServiceManager
  • public class ServiceManager
extends Object
    Service layer responsible for administrative management of ServiceInstance entities.

    This class provides functionality for creating, modifying, and deleting service instances, as well as updating scheduling configurations and visibility.

    All operations enforce authorization by verifying that the given administrator has access to the target Restaurant.

    Scheduling behavior: Service creation logic varies depending on the restaurant's SchedulingType:

    • DATE_ONLY: Creates a single service for the entire date
    • FIXED_TIME_SLOTS: Creates a single service at a specified time
    • DATE_TIME: Generates multiple services in 15-minute increments within a time range

    • Method Detail

      • addService

        public void addService​(Long adminId,
                       Long restaurantId,
                       LocalDate date,
                       LocalTime time,
                       LocalTime endTime,
                       int capacity)
        Adds one or more service instances for a restaurant based on its scheduling type.

        This method first verifies that the administrator has permission to manage the specified restaurant. It then creates service instances according to the restaurant's SchedulingType:

        • DATE_ONLY: Creates a single service at midnight representing the entire day
        • FIXED_TIME_SLOTS: Creates a single service at the specified time
        • DATE_TIME: Creates multiple services at 15-minute intervals between time (inclusive) and endTime (exclusive)

        All created services are initialized as visible and assigned the specified capacity.

        Parameters:
        adminId - the ID of the administrator performing the action
        restaurantId - the ID of the restaurant
        date - the date of the service(s)
        time - the start time (required for FIXED_TIME_SLOTS and DATE_TIME)
        endTime - the end time (required for DATE_TIME)
        capacity - the maximum number of guests for each service instance
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if:
        • The administrator is not authorized for the restaurant
        • The restaurant does not exist
        • Required time parameters are missing or invalid

      • deleteService

        public void deleteService​(Long adminId,
                          Long serviceId)
        Deletes a service instance if it has no associated reservations.

        This method verifies administrator authorization and ensures that the service instance does not have any existing reservations before deletion.

        Parameters:
        adminId - the ID of the administrator performing the action
        serviceId - the ID of the service instance to delete
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the service does not exist or access is unauthorized
        IllegalStateException - if the service has existing reservations

      • updateSchedulingType

        public void updateSchedulingType​(Long adminId,
                                 Long restaurantId,
                                 String schedulingType)
        Updates the scheduling type of a restaurant.

        This affects how future service instances should be created and interpreted.

        Parameters:
        adminId - the ID of the administrator performing the action
        restaurantId - the ID of the restaurant
        schedulingType - the new scheduling type (case-insensitive)
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the restaurant does not exist, the scheduling type is invalid, or access is unauthorized

      • toggleVisibility

        public void toggleVisibility​(Long adminId,
                             Long serviceId)
        Toggles the visibility of a service instance.

        Invisible services are typically hidden from booking interfaces but remain in the system.

        Parameters:
        adminId - the ID of the administrator performing the action
        serviceId - the ID of the service instance
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the service does not exist or access is unauthorized

      • authorizeAdminAccess

        public void authorizeAdminAccess​(Long adminId,
                                 Long restaurantId)
        Verifies that an administrator has access to a specific restaurant.

        This method retrieves all restaurant IDs associated with the administrator and checks whether the target restaurant is included.

        Parameters:
        adminId - the administrator ID
        restaurantId - the restaurant ID to validate access for
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the administrator does not have access
